purpose: Reproducible evidence inventory for a subject-vs-peers comparison. It replaces an unpublished six-dimension equal-weight point score whose numbers carried no provenance and were computed against a stale revision. v0.2 adds the declared-judgment channel and a side-by-side comparison view. It does not amend v0.1 evidence, which stays frozen and untouched as a separate protocol identity.

evidence_tiers.V: Subject only. The anchor string is present in the committed tree of the pinned subject commit, resolved via git object lookup. Never the working tree.
evidence_tiers.T1: Verbatim quotation from a vendor-published page, with the exact URL and the retrieval date. Comparable across vendors.
evidence_tiers.T2: A vendor-published page was identified and dated; the claim is a paraphrase, not a verbatim quotation.
evidence_tiers.T3: A third-party report or press item, not vendor-published.
evidence_tiers.T4: Model-derived prose with no retrievable source. Not evidence.

rungs.0: No declared mechanical anchor for this dimension is present.
rungs.2: Durable state plus a recovery or identity path present.
rungs.3: Mechanical identity/generation binding or a settlement/authority path present.
rungs.4: All declared anchors for this dimension present, including the dimension-declared counter-anchors.

rung_semantics: A rung is the highest declared evidence rung whose required anchors are all verified present and whose forbidden anchors are all verified absent. It is a verified lower bound on the evidence, not a measurement of capability degree. A rung is not comparable across dimensions and must not be averaged.
band_emission_rule: A numeric rung may be emitted only from tier V (subject) or tier T1 (counterparty). T2/T3/T4 cells carry no number, at any position in any table.

dimensions.name: Long-horizon autonomy
dimensions.definition: Whether a declared objective with durable state survives interrupted execution and continues without re-instruction.

anchors.proves: Goal completion reads a mechanical task-frontier open count rather than prose.
The model can persist a goal checkpoint as a first-class action.
Mechanical adjacency reconstruction of the most recent completed exchange.
Program-originated recovery facts are distinguishable from human turns.
Parent/child delegation topology is journaled as a durable fact.

counter_anchors.proves_absent: No project/coordinator layer that plans and dispatches a fleet across processes.

dimensions.name: Concurrency and isolation
dimensions.definition: Whether concurrent execution is bounded by mechanical ownership and whether each concurrent unit has its own physical execution environment.

anchors.proves: A central governor leases and settles concurrent resource use.
Execution classes are declared as a typed contract.
Each provider call carries a mechanical identity used for settlement.
Command execution can be isolated in a container with no network and a read-only rootfs.
A delegated child executes in its own session with a bounded depth.

counter_anchors.proves_absent: No per-agent execution-environment identity. Isolation today is command-scoped, not agent-scoped; the delegated child shares the caller's workspace.
No worker lease/reclaim protocol distinct from the provider-call lease.

dimensions.name: Context and recovery
dimensions.definition: Whether interrupted or compacted execution can be resumed with the same execution semantics, and whether exact sources remain model-reachable.

anchors.proves: A prompt-neutral aggregate of the current provider attempt's mechanical identity facts.
Session-scoped workspace identity and partition are established at lifecycle boundary.
Mailbox, report, result and cancel records are journaled for delegated work.
A model-invokable exact read path over durable evidence.
Evidence access is scope-authorized and denial is a typed outcome.
A dispatched mutation leaves a durable receipt usable for recovery.

dimensions.name: Runtime reliability
dimensions.definition: Whether the live process's identity, configuration and authority are exact, declared and fail-closed.

anchors.proves: A redacted effective-config fingerprint is computed and persisted.
Configuration precedence is resolved mechanically with per-key sources.
Exact tracked-source and release identity facts are computed.
Workspace identity is derived mechanically and validated.
Tool effects and their mutation authority are bound to the exact call identity.

dimensions.name: Observability and governance
dimensions.definition: Whether execution facts are auditable with provenance, and whether a declared policy can be enforced without being silently relaxed.

anchors.proves: Evidence refs are verified for authenticity and integrity at task completion.
Provider resource facts are projected with validity and freshness.
Vendor facts are attributed to an authoritative snapshot with declared applicability.
Cache behaviour is tracked as a performance fact with a breaker.
Cache prefix identity is described mechanically per window.
A wait condition is validated as a typed predicate rather than free text.

counter_anchors.proves_absent: No user-facing surface presenting agent tree, lease, settlement, recovery provenance and evidence provenance together. The facts exist; the view does not.

dimensions.name: Ecosystem and UX
dimensions.definition: Whether external models, harnesses, tools and humans can enter and drive the runtime through declared interfaces.
dimensions.in_repo_measurable_note: Distribution and adoption cannot be observed from this repository at all. A rung here bounds only the declared interface anchors, never the dimension.

anchors.proves: External MCP servers can be registered as model-visible tools.
The runtime can expose its own capability over MCP to an external harness.
External skill packages are discoverable from a directory.
A human-facing streaming surface exists.
Human input can be queued durably against a live session.
A second human channel can resume work with anchor and precheck.

counter_anchors.proves_absent: No ACP or equivalent harness-neutral adapter layer, so a foreign harness cannot drive this runtime over a declared protocol.
No distribution or adoption fact of any kind is tracked in-repo, so this dimension is not measurable from this repository at all.

counterparty_cells.claim: Vendor-published announcement of a project-level object that maintains shared context across months, with a coordinator that plans and dispatches execution agents.
Vendor states project execution runs on separate cloud computers and can additionally dispatch local agents.
Release page exists for the named version; the worktree-isolation and external-message details are restated from a secondary description, not quoted from the page.
A release feed exists describing resume, subagent tool-list and background-session fixes; item-level text was not retrieved verbatim.
Vendor changelog entry exists for enterprise-managed permissions over agent operations; the precedence detail is restated from a secondary description.
Vendor product page exists describing concurrent agents; the per-agent git worktree detail is restated from a secondary description.
A vendor changelog page exists; no dated entry text was retrieved verbatim.
